title: Experts disagree on new scope job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
context:
Chief architect: the two claims agree (narrow read permissions on the job only, never workflow-wide); this is a pick only because a must-level security finding cannot be merged by the chair. The security claim is recommended because it also carries the pull_request trigger rule and the fail-to-full-matrix rule on a lookup error; the architect's job-level placement still applies through EX-devops-engineer-3

Target: new scope job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
- security-auditor: the scope job runs under the existing permissions: contents: read plus only checks: read and pull-requests: read, keeps the pull_request trigger (never pull_request_target), and on any API error or rate limit it outputs release_only=false so the full matrix runs
- application-architect: the workflow permissions today are contents: read only; the scope job and the release ci-green step need pull-requests: read and checks: read (or statuses: read) on the job, not widened workflow-wide
